- [ASSISTANT] Hiking is suggested as a must-try activity in the Natural Park of Moncayo mountain in Aragón.
- [ASSISTANT] The GR-90 is recommended as one of the best hiking trails with breathtaking views, approximately 36 kilometers long, taking two to three days to complete.
- [ASSISTANT] Highlights of the GR-90 trail include reaching the summit of Moncayo mountain and experiencing the Fuenfría waterfall.
- [PREFERENCE] User expresses excitement about the hike and asks for the best time of year to go.
- [ASSISTANT] The ideal time for hiking in the Natural Park of Moncayo mountain is during spring and autumn.
- [ASSISTANT] Spring offers blooming wildflowers and mild climate, while autumn provides vibrant colors of forest leaves and refreshing weather.
- [ASSISTANT] Summer can be challenging due to high temperatures and crowds, while winter offers skiing activities.
- [PREFERENCE] User decides to plan their trip in the autumn.
